name: request_book
description: Idempotently request one explicitly selected ebook in Bookshelf using its signed request_token. The request is returned with a durable request_id, status requested/searching, terminal false, and a 300-second check suggestion. To follow up, offer exactly one recurring manage_cron entry that calls ebooks/check_book_request with this request_id; cron replies are not auto-delivered, so explicitly call send_telegram_message with the outcome. When terminal is true or 48 hours have elapsed, notify the user and delete that cron entry.

request_token.description: Required opaque signed token returned for the exact user-selected search candidate. Never substitute candidate_id, title, or author.

search_now.description: Whether Bookshelf should start an immediate bounded BookSearch where supported (default true).
